recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast nighttime photograph of a group of traditional African dancers in ceremonial attire, performing with drums on grass, framed by a geometric patterned top border and expressive, layered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: White brush-script text against a deep black void
Rhythmic repetition of dancers across the horizontal plane
Warm straw and skin tones popping against a cool dark background
Geometric precision of the top border versus organic movement below
coreInvariants: Dancers wearing white body paint and feathered headpieces
A thin, colorful geometric border at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Dancers occupy the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a mid-shot perspective; typography is centered in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dancer with the most prominent white body paint and forward-facing drum.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large white script, drops to the red subtitle, and then follows the diagonal lines of the drums and dancers' limbs from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper half creates a stage-like spotlight effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black (background) and dark green (grass) providing a high-contrast stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (body paint, feathers, script) for maximum legibility and focus.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red (subtitle and border accents) and warm ochre (drums and straw skirts).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subjects and the background; moderate saturation in the skin tones and grass.
paletteRestrictions: Limit the background to true black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive brush script and condensed serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses varying stroke weights mimicking a flat brush
Ascenders and descenders are elongated and expressive
Secondary text is a rigid, all-caps condensed serif with tight tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' has a long, sweeping horizontal bar
The 'y' has a sharp, straight descender
The 'O' is slightly tilted and open-stroked
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic script paired with a rigid, geometric serif for structural balance.
graphicDevices: Top-edge geometric border with red, green, and white triangles

preserve: The brush-stroke texture of the main title
The red color of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the primary title
Provides the condensed, heavy-weight structure for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast photograph of African dancers in traditional straw skirts and feathered headpieces with white body paint, playing drums on a dark green grass field at night. The upper half of the image should be solid black. Include a thin geometric border at the very top edge featuring red and green patterns.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a large, white, hand-lettered brush script title in the black space. Directly beneath it, place a second line of text in a bold, condensed, all-caps red serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the upper half of the image predominantly black?
Are the dancers wearing white body paint and feathers?
Is the main title in a white brush script?
Is there a red condensed subtitle?
Is there a geometric border at the top?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the spotlight effect on the grass
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Unique catalog numbers in the corner
Exact geometric pattern of the border

mustAchieve: High contrast between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast 'spotlight' lighting on subjects
Ensure text is centered and vertically stacked
Verify the presence of the top-edge border
Confirm the script text looks hand-painted
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast night photography + expressive brush script + condensed serif subtitle + cultural performance subject matter.
